events.text: Year 11 brought poor growing weather (yields at 85%).
Soren Juniper founded Soren Juniper's Bakery, investing 2,031 marks.
Hollis Voss and Soren Juniper welcomed their first child, Sabine Juniper.
Perrin Heath became the richest person World 1 has ever known, with 28,272 marks.
Hollin Larkin starved to death at age 69.
The Larkin household came to an end.
Hester Ashdown starved to death at age 71, leaving behind Ivo Elwood.
Ivo Elwood starved to death at age 71.
The Elwood household came to an end.
Food shortage in World 1: only 84% of food needs are being met.

The Crane household came to an end.
Fenna Heath starved to death at age 31, leaving behind Madoc Moss.
